facts: An operable definition of focus is presented.
The presented definition of focus is argued to be of a cognito-pragmatic nature.
The determination of focus in discourse is explored.
The determination of focus is explored in a formalized manner.
A file card model of discourse model and knowledge store is introduced.
The file card model enables the decomposition of the determination process as a programmable algorithm (FDA).
The file card model enables the formal representation of the determination process as a programmable algorithm (FDA).
Interdisciplinary evidence from social psychology is cited.
Interdisciplinary evidence from cognitive psychology is cited.
The prospect of the integration of focus via FDA as a discourse-level construct into speech synthesis systems is briefly discussed.
The prospect of the integration of focus via FDA into concept-to-speech systems is briefly discussed.
Concept-to-speech systems are speech synthesis systems.
Focus via FDA is a discourse-level construct.
Interdisciplinary evidence from social and cognitive psychology is cited.
entities: a file card model of discourse model and knowledge store
